title: kith-tui: JMAP client + EventSource
description: Implement an async JMAP client module inside kith-tui that talks to a running kithd instance. Covers: (1) read kithd TLS cert DER from data dir so reqwest can pin it; (2) GET /jmap/session to discover accountId and state; (3) POST /jmap/api wrapper that sends a JmapRequest and returns the parsed response; (4) SSE client for GET /jmap/events that emits StateChange events over an mpsc channel. No UI wiring yet — just the client layer with unit tests using a mock HTTP server (wiremock or axum-test).
